prompt: During an online game, your friend loses a close round, angrily blames your mistake in the voice chat, and logs off. What response best protects the friendship?

options.text: Send a string of messages proving it was not your fault
Give it a little time, then message to say the blame stung and ask if they are okay
Remove them from your friends list before they do it to you
Tell the rest of the squad they always react like this

explanation: Waiting until tempers cool and then naming how it felt honestly addresses the moment without escalating a heated game into a feud.
